steps.content:
May 29, N.F. 116
BR-003 High-Altitude Observation Hub

At 10 a.m., led by Chief ${PlayerName}, the MBCC's team launches attacks on two suspected Underground bases. This large-scale operation is executed under considerable tension. At the same time, experiment preparations at the BR-003 High-Altitude Observation Hub come to a sudden halt.

An EDGE unit seizes the observation station without prior warning or explanation. The control room is in lockdown and the scientists' work is suspended. The young researchers are corralled away from their stations, and their tasks are taken over completely.

And the one assuming control of everything is a palm-sized Schorl. ${PlayerName} was accompanied by an identical one during the previous visit, but now, the little device somehow appears completely different.
Right now, the flawless black bipyramid hovers at exactly 1.618 meters above the ground. Rotating slowly as it absorbs data, it seems to be surveying everything below simultaneously.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: ...What's going on?
Sarah is still dumbfounded. She was in the middle of adjusting an equation when they pulled her away. The normally timid girl uncharacteristically demands to return to her station.

steps.speaker: Barrie
steps.content: We still need to run the final verification on the theory. Can't you wait just a moment? I mean...

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The verification won't be necessary. Your proposal was thoroughly assessed upon submission. The implementation procedures are clear. The work can be easily transferred.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Well done on completing your mission. We'll take over the Observation Hub from here.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: Stop patronizing us. I know what this means.

steps.speaker: Sarah
steps.content: A change of this magnitude doesn't just happen without prior announcement. Replacing the staff with only six hours' notice is simply ridiculous. We're not...

Before she can finish, a row of Hush humanoid soldiers turns their heads in unison, eerie masks locking onto them, mirroring the terrified young faces. Sarah flinches, instinctively shrinking closer to Barrie. The boy shields her with his own round frame.
But he's scared too, his voice no longer as relaxed as it was when he was doling out potato chips earlier.

steps.speaker: Barrie
steps.content: Does EDGE mean to tell us that... we made a mistake?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: That is not EDGE's intention. However, a detailed evaluation of the proposal will involve classified information. Following the transfer of authority over the Observation Hub, you are no longer authorized to access such information.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Please follow our instructions and exit the control room. Arrangements will be made for all of you.
Only one person steps forward.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: ...I've received no prior notice. I'm demanding an explanation.
Lemma steps out and stands in front of Schorl. As EDGE-07, she shouldn't fear such a mass-produced device. She tells herself as she clenches her fists.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Simply put, EDGE has received credible intelligence that would explain the frequent attacks on the Observation Hub. The real reason isn't merely the technological gap between the enemy and us...

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...There's a leaker inside the Hub. And it's very likely a senior technical expert who's crossed critical security boundaries.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Security has thus become the top priority. An investigation must be conducted immediately. That's all.
The news is too shocking for Enya. She cries out.

steps.speaker: Enya
steps.content: How is that possible?! Everyone here has devoted themselves to this project. It shouldn't even be possible with all the data security systems we have in place. And even if it were, why would anyone sabotage a project they've poured years of their life into?!

steps.speaker: Enya
steps.content: Let's just say there really is a security risk, that you suspect there's a... spy in the Hub. Do you really need to replace the entire staff because of one or two people? Who's going to maintain all this equipment? What will happen to our research?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Your concerns are valid. Rest assured, EDGE won't resort to such foolish measures.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We monitor everyone's behavior, but we only take action against specific targets—those under the heaviest suspicion.

steps.speaker: Enya
steps.content: ...What do you mean? You're suspecting... us?

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Enya!
Lemma stops her colleague. She has heard of situations like this, has even voted to approve similar orders herself, but this...
This is the first time she witnesses and experiences it firsthand. She understands clearly that this conversation cannot go on, at least not in front of everyone.
Keylan-II is hidden in her pocket. Lemma tries to concentrate, activating the brainwave communication discreetly.

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: EDGE-07 requests... an emergency meeting immediately.

steps.speaker: Keylan-II
steps.content: Request received, EDGE-07. Requesting synchronization.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: As you wish. Requesting synchronization.
[Scene transition. EDGE communication channel]
Once she's connected to the channel, Lemma realizes 03 is the only other numbered channel joining the meeting.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> ...Where are the others?
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03:</color> You called an emergency meeting. The other representatives must be occupied with their other tasks. I'll relay their opinions.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03: </color>Back to your question. You wish to discuss the matter about the Observation Hub? Then, first, compose yourself, and be rational, 07. My time is limited as well. Please set aside your personal emotions so that we can communicate efficiently.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>Don't patronize me. I don't need your lecture on the importance of being rational.
She takes a deep breath.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>The Observation Hub is being taken over due to a "leak," but that's just a pretext, isn't it?
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>I already reported the relevant security concerns long ago. SHP-13 also acknowledged the possibility of an internal leak. We've proven through experimentation that the Underground's threat can be prevented and managed. On the contrary...

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>You stormed the Hub without prior notice to its current administrator. EDGE made this decision without letting 07 participate in the discussion. None of this aligns with established protocol. I demand an explanation.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03: </color>A reasonable request. Syncing data to EDGE-07's channel. Please approve the transmission.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>Transmission approved.
[Electromagnetic sound effect, static screen, 1s]
An influx of data floods her mind. Eight requests to review 07's qualifications in regard to her eligibility for the position within a single year. Lemma's eyes widen.
She suddenly realizes what has transpired behind her back during the year she spent consumed by research, too absorbed to spare any attention for anything else.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03: </color>It is true that most research projects you've overseen have seen fast progress. But the "flagship" projects have consistently failed to meet expectations, incurring excessive monetary and time costs, not to mention the vast amounts of research resources consumed.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03:</color> Take the current BR-003 dimensional Mania analysis project as an example.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03: </color>You've failed seven critical verification procedures. On three occasions, your insistence led to unjustified modifications to the development plan. Last month, you once again rejected the simplified proposal submitted by the technical advisors, further extending the project timeline. This resulted in a series of consequences, the most severe being that...

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03: </color>The Ring Research Institute's commitment to Nirvana last year, the development of next-generation unmanned mining technology, has seen zero progress. Research on Aurum Secretum has also fallen severely behind schedule.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03:</color> EDGE has since initiated a comprehensive review covering all 36 months of your tenure. Your performance in professional decision-making, resource allocation, cost control, and project transparency has been less than satisfactory. More concerning is your overall conduct. Specifically...
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03: </color><color=#FFBC6F>We're seeing very little cooperation from you, which severely impacts your reliability.</color>
She clenches her fists even harder.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>A review? So what you're saying is I should abandon the hard, crucial problems and waste my time on meaningless, time-consuming garbage projects instead?
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>Just because you think they're "important" and "the previous staff didn't do a good job," you want to waste a brilliant mind on these projects?  So they can "boost completion rates," "make the review metrics look better," "keep the public happy"... and "keep me from coming under scrutiny"?
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>And you're questioning my project management and transparency... Does my work violate the Security and Confidentiality Protocol? Or do you want daily reports? Would there even be time left to do actual work? And when I do report, how many of you can even understand it, or bother to listen seriously?

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03: </color>Be rational, Representative 07. Your talent is beyond question. But overdependence on it creates problems.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color><size=42>Such as non-cooperation?</size>

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07:</color> I've given my full technical support to every decision passed at these meetings. Even during the Ash Campaign...
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>I was strongly against deploying the disaster deterrent due to its risks. But I respected the voting result and expedited adjustments to the Black Ring facilities to execute the plan. And yet I was the one dealing with the resulting damage, exposure risks, and endless side effects.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>How much more cooperative do you want me to be? What more can I do?
EDGE-03: Be rational.
It feels humiliating to be reminded of that as a scientist. Lemma's nails dig into her palms.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>Each EDGE representative has their own sacred duty. 07 is responsible for integrating research resources, advancing key technological development, and undertaking core projects vital to society.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>BR-003 has been compromised. The Underground's threat persists. We must reverse our strategic disadvantage. Mania dimension technology is clearly the...
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03:</color><size=42> 07's responsibility is to advance scientific development and accomplish the assigned tasks.</size>
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03: </color><size=42>You are not responsible for determining which projects deserve more progress and which do not. That duty belongs to other members.</size>

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03: </color><size=42>Your job is to participate in discussions, accept the decisions, and execute them faithfully. But lately, you've been far too impulsive. You've overstepped your bounds repeatedly.</size>

EDGE-07: Who made these complaints? 06 never speaks up. 08 is still new, and often misses these meetings while away. You don't want her too involved anyway. EDGE-07: That leaves us with Nirvana, the Council... and you, am I right? EDGE-03: You know I'm not allowed to disclose that. EDGE-07: You don't need to tell me. I can work it out myself. In this so-called qualification review process, three of the seven seats have aligned against me. You plan to sway those two abstentions to guarantee the outcome. EDGE-07: But I still have an ongoing collaboration with SHP-13, and it's entering a critical phase. That... EDGE-03: I certainly hope you're not invoking that connection to put pressure on me. EDGE members must be wary of conflicts of interest, particularly where he is concerned. EDGE-07: That wasn't my point. Let me restate my point bearing in mind the rationality and responsibility expected of me as 07.
steps.female_content: EDGE-07: Who made these complaints? 06 never speaks up. 08 is still new, and often misses these meetings while away. You don't want her too involved anyway. EDGE-07: That leaves us with Nirvana, the Council... and you, am I right? EDGE-03: You know I'm not allowed to disclose that. EDGE-07: You don't need to tell me. I can work it out myself. In this so-called qualification review process, three of the seven seats have aligned against me. You plan to sway those two abstentions to guarantee the outcome. EDGE-07: But I still have an ongoing collaboration with SHP-13, and it's entering a critical phase. That... EDGE-03: I certainly hope you're not invoking that connection to put pressure on me. EDGE members must be wary of conflicts of interest, particularly where she is concerned. EDGE-07: That wasn't my point. Let me restate my point bearing in mind the rationality and responsibility expected of me as 07.

steps.content:
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>SHP-13's proposal was formally approved and authorized for execution at the last EDGE meeting. That means <size=42>you acknowledged the importance of his proposal</size>, and you agreed that <size=42>BR-003's security</size>, as well as <size=42>the tracking of and counterattack on the Underground</size> are the top priorities.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>That being the case, we must close the technological gap between the Underground and us in dimensional Mania applications, and locate their hideout before they move again. I've been leading this project for three years. Objectively speaking, I am its core.
steps.female_content:
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>SHP-13's proposal was formally approved and authorized for execution at the last EDGE meeting. That means <size=42>you acknowledged the importance of her proposal</size>, and you agreed that <size=42>BR-003's security</size>, as well as <size=42>the tracking of and counterattack on the Underground</size> are the top priorities.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>That being the case, we must close the technological gap between the Underground and us in dimensional Mania applications, and locate their hideout before they move again. I've been leading this project for three years. Objectively speaking, I am its core.

steps.content:
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>You're replacing the core personnel at the most critical phase of this project while a major conflict is looming. EDGE's research function will inevitably be disrupted. Can you bear the consequences?
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03: </color>Regarding that, the members have conducted a thorough professional assessment. A replacement is ready to take over. There will be no issues.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color><size=60>And who exactly conducted this assessment?</size>

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>A vote of no confidence against me can be done by all representatives except myself. That is true. But you're assessing if I have the right qualifications to take on a scientific position at EDGE...
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>And you're telling me the opinions of scientists don't matter? You're letting three laymen make the final call?
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color><size=60>Did you consult with 01 and 02?!</size>
A silence.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03: </color>You're right. The opinions of 01 and 02 are extremely important.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03: </color>EDGE-01 is currently engaged in another mission. He's determined that he lacks the bandwidth to properly assess other matters. He has thus responsibly declared his abstention in advance.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>What?! You...
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03: </color>EDGE-02 will exercise his voting right on his behalf. As for EDGE-02...
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03: </color>On this matter, your mentor has cast her vote in favor. She also provided us with the key technical justification we needed.
The turbulence in her brainwaves disrupts the connection. A splitting headache makes Lemma lose her focus, and she can barely stay connected to the channel.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>She... said that?
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>What about the evaluation report... and the documents I submitted... What exactly did she say? What did I... fail to do...
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-07: </color>Let me see it. Why...

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03: </color>Don't worry. She cares little about those documents I shared with you previously. 02 never invests her energy in such administrative matters.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03: </color>Those are simply the reasons we've compiled for official purposes, and ones we hope you'll accept. It would be in all parties' best interests that you accept this explanation.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03:</color> Your gift of ██ is unparalleled, and you've always taken pride in it... So in the end, emotionally speaking, ██... this is the best way to handle it.
<i>Wait, this isn't right...

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03: </color>The real reason 02 provided is actually far simpler. However, ██...
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03: </color>That is information beyond your current clearance level.
<i>...Wait... I still...
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-03: </color>Goodbye, Lemma Herzfeld. Thank you for your contributions during your three years of service.
[System Update] EDGE-07 channel authentication terminated. Permissions revoked. Effective immediately. [Unauthorized Channel]: Wait... Ahh!!

Her permissions are taken, and the connection is severed abruptly. Lemma's consciousness is expelled, her vision violently snapping back to the control room. The emotional impact compounds with the reaction from the neural link, sending a wave of vertigo through her. She staggers, on the verge of collapsing to the floor.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Pink flash!

Someone quickly darts to Lemma's side, catching her. The sudden movement triggers Hush's built-in reaction, and several soldiers begin moving. But almost simultaneously, electrical currents rush through the alarm chips in their skulls. The Hush soldiers quickly realize...

A drone hovers behind each of their heads. Several meters away, Summer supports Lemma with one arm while her other hand works a projection keyboard, her eyes locked on every artificial soldier. Her expression is darker than ever.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: You brainless pieces of scrap... Nobody move, or I'll blow everything above your necks off.

steps.speaker: Summer
steps.content: Not everyone here works for the Ring Research Institute. I'm an MBCC-registered Sinner. You wanna mess with a genius like me? You gotta ask ${PlayerName} first.

The Hush soldiers stop. Before them stands an S-Class Sinner who once single-handedly crippled the Laboratory of Parma. Moreover, she's a prized talent the Ring Research Institute has been trying to recruit. The units receive a new order that forbids them from escalating the conflict.
And the person issuing that command is drifting closer, in the form of a black bipyramid. It descends slightly before the two girls, rotating leisurely and behaving strangely amiably.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Of course, we still wish to continue with our research on Mania's effects on a person's intelligence, and you're an exceptional and valuable subject. EDGE cherishes its good relationship with Chief ${PlayerName}, and we both respect each other's roles and jurisdictions.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: But I take it that you don't care about any of that right now. You just want to throw a tantrum, don't you?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: And you're certainly capable of that. When a true genius sets their mind to something big, the consequences often exceed what ordinary brains can fathom and withstand.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Planning to surprise ${PlayerName} when he's not watching? <color=#fb9259>Like when you raised hell at the Ring Research Institute five years ago</color>? Back then, your parents' reactions were rather entertaining.
steps.female_content: Planning to surprise ${PlayerName} when she's not watching? <color=#fb9259>Like when you raised hell at the Ring Research Institute five years ago</color>? Back then, your parents' reactions were rather entertaining.

steps.content: Summer is speechless, mouth agape. Her extraordinary mind has just connected the dots. Something isn't right about this black bipyramid.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Alright, then let's wait for ${PlayerName} to return. You trust his judgment, don't you? We won't do anything to harm your friend either. Lemma is a valuable asset. Let me speak with her. She needs me.
steps.female_content: Alright, then let's wait for ${PlayerName} to return. You trust her judgment, don't you? We won't do anything to harm your friend either. Lemma is a valuable asset. Let me speak with her. She needs me.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I must be tactful about certain things, but once I offer my explanation, I'm sure she'll understand.

Lemma still hasn't recovered from the shock. The black bipyramid observes for a moment, then, slowly and gently, lowers itself and connects to Keylan-II, now stripped of eighty percent of its functions.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Poor child. The sudden severance just now has left you disoriented, I see. Now then, think back for a moment. Five years ago, based on your achievements, qualifications, data, and behavioral assessments, you and Summer were both selected as candidates for EDGE-07.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Do you know why we chose you in the end?

steps.speaker: Lemma
steps.content: Because Summer... is a Sinner... because she was contaminated by Mania?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Indeed. Her cognition was disrupted by Mania, rendering it sometimes unpredictable and chaotic. You, by contrast, have a perfectly logical mind and well-defined methodologies. You excelled at summarizing knowledge and sharing it. Your teamwork skills were also outstanding. Therefore, we determined...

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Your experience could be effectively summarized, studied, and replicated. And we've been proven right.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: You were the "genius" who best suited our needs, the perfect choice for EDGE-07.
Lemma's eyes widen. Her brainwaves are still erratic. Her consciousness is drifting, and her senses are blurry.
What happens after that?

The sealed doors of the control room burst open. Someone rushes in, shouting something. The Hush soldiers seem hesitant. Lemma's frightened colleagues cry as they gather around the intruder. Perhaps they're safe now.
But Lemma can hear none of the comforting words, can make out none of the faces.
The only thing she can see clearly is the hovering black bipyramid. It finishes what it needs to say, then rises back to its original position.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Look. The next EDGE-07 candidate has arrived. She has worked hard and achieved outstanding results. She deserves recognition. Until EDGE officially retrieves all data, she will assume temporary control of the Observation Hub.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Our strategy remains unchanged. No matter who EDGE chooses to be in charge, protecting BR-003, advancing the technology, and tackling the Underground will always be our top priorities.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We are about to face an enormous challenge. Before humanity's true enemy arrives, we must make thorough preparations to ensure a seamless transition of operations under all circumstances. Now, initiate the authority transfer procedures.
Is she imagining it? Through Schorl's pristine, flawless surface, Lemma seems to glimpse another face, one that belongs to someone familiar, someone she admires and misses.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Come say your goodbyes, Lemma.
